packageRules.description: Shared preset bumps merge themselves once the pull request checks are green: no dashboard tick, no release-age soak, their own branch. The preset is Webgrip's own reviewed code, released from this repository, and every consumer waiting for a tick on it is a policy fix that has not landed. Renovate's automerge, not the platform's, so a branch without checks does not merge at once. It is never digest-pinned: It is already pinned to a protected semver release tag; the global pinDigests=true otherwise makes Renovate try to rewrite 'github>webgrip/renovate-config#vX.Y.Z' to a commit SHA, the replacement never applies ('Digest is not updated'), and the whole pin-dependencies branch aborts with 'Error updating branch: update failure' on every run. A preset bump changes how Renovate treats the repository, not what it ships, so it lands as chore(renovate) and never cuts a release.. The generator appends this part to every preset it builds, so no grouping, soak or commit-type rule of an earlier part can catch the bump.
